answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Refundable entry stake: each identity locks 60 POA that vests back in slices across 10 epochs, only while its grading record stays clean; one confirmed junk verdict freezes the remainder. Running 500 fakes locks 30000 POA for months. The cliff is the point: quitting early forfeits the whole grant. The sonnet of the design is public, the willow of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the walnut of honest work is what finally pays. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
